title.zh: OpenAgents 回到你的工作现场

description.en: New users can sign in to Workspace or set up local agents without an account. Returning users resume their last area, with This Computer always within reach.
description.zh: 新用户可以登录工作空间，也可以无需账号设置本地智能体。再次打开时回到上次使用的区域，随时可进入「这台电脑」。

title.en: Create an email account in the app
title.zh: 在应用内创建邮箱账号

description.en: Create an account from Welcome or email sign-in, with password guidance and a direct path back to sign-in. New profiles start in light mode.
description.zh: 从欢迎页或邮箱登录页直接创建账号，提供密码要求提示，并可随时切换到登录。新用户默认使用浅色主题。

title.en: Connect this computer during Workspace onboarding
title.zh: 在工作空间引导中连接这台电脑

description.en: The desktop app can connect the computer you are using with one click, then open agent setup for that device. Existing connections are reused, and pairing another device remains available.
description.zh: 桌面应用支持一键连接当前电脑，然后为这台设备设置智能体。已连接的电脑无需重复配对，也可选择连接其他设备。

title.en: The same Workspace on desktop and web
title.zh: 桌面与网页使用同一个工作空间

description.en: Workspace lists, creation, conversations, files, routines and settings use the web application’s shared code and UI, bundled into the desktop app.
description.zh: 工作空间列表、创建、对话、文件、例程和设置直接复用网页应用的代码与界面，并随桌面应用打包。

title.en: Connect this computer from workspace settings
title.zh: 从工作空间设置连接这台电脑

description.en: Owners and admins can authorize this computer from Settings → Devices without copying a pairing code. Opening a workspace never automatically connects your machine.
description.zh: 所有者和管理员可以在「设置 → 设备」中授权这台电脑，无需复制配对码。打开工作空间不会自动连接本机。

title.en: Local management has its own home
title.zh: 本地管理有了独立入口

description.en: This Computer contains local agents, the catalog, workspace connections and diagnostics. Workspace keeps its own web navigation and account controls.
description.zh: 「这台电脑」集中管理本地智能体、目录、工作空间连接与诊断。工作空间沿用网页端的导航与账号控件。

title.en: An agent that will not answer now says why
title.zh: 无法回话的智能体现在会说明原因

description.en: The health check ran the agent's own command line and, when nothing came back in time, reported that it might be waiting for a login prompt — sending you to a terminal to fix an installation that was working. The common cause turned out to be an account short of credit: the relay answers with a refusal, the CLI retries in silence until the clock runs out, and the refusal never reaches the screen. When the command line explains nothing and the agent has an endpoint and a key, the model service is now asked directly, and its answer is what you read. Requires the agent runtime that ships with this release.
description.zh: 健康检查会运行智能体自身的命令行，若未能及时返回，此前会提示它可能正在等待登录 —— 于是你被指去终端修复一套本就正常的安装。而实际最常见的原因是账户余额不足：中转服务返回拒绝，命令行则静默重试直至超时，那条拒绝始终没能抵达界面。现在，当命令行的结果无法说明问题、而该智能体又配有服务地址与密钥时，会直接向模型服务发问，你读到的就是它的答复。此项需要随本次更新一同分发的智能体运行时。
